item.title: Community Spotlight: Mapping OWASP Risks with Praxen
item.dc:creator: Open Agent and AI Security Community
item.description: Community member Steve Wilson used Praxen to test 12 open-source agent projects against both the OWASP LLM and Agentic Top 10 — and found the two risk taxonomies overlap more than most people expect.
